title: Weekly planning session every Wednesday before the usage reset
note: CORRECTION, operator 2026-10-29 ~12:15Z verbatim: "I don't know where we got the standing robot deploy pop-ups. That's incorrect. In general, there are specific items where you might need my explicit permission to deploy, but in general, and definitely anything covering UI, deploy automatically does not need me to weigh in on something like that." Supersedes the manager's reading of the ~10:00Z rule ('bring ready deploys as popups'): the 10:00Z rule meant ready work never waits for a planned date. Manager practice from now: green Tier-1/Tier-2 work (incl. runtime, API, UI, observability) is merged AND deployed automatically, verified (merged -> deployed -> observed) and reported after; explicit operator permission only for Tier-3 (strategy logic/params, risk caps/sizing, account-mode flips, live/real-money promotion) and irreversible actions.

observation.what: the 2026-10-14 Wednesday planning run publishes a plan Artifact with all four parts, the checklist/queue additions land, and every recurring session for the week is confirmed scheduled before the reset
